title: 耐用品订单超预期：消费却停滞，美国经济怎么了
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We've got a lot of numbers this morning, but the first ones out are durable goods, so I'll give you that very quickly.
segments.zh: 今早数据很多，但最先公布的是耐用品订单，我简单说一下。

segments.en: Up 1.1% double, more than double the analyst's expectations.
segments.zh: 环比上涨1.1%，是分析师预期的两倍多。

segments.en: OK, here's the numbers that matter to everybody this morning. And that's the PCE price indexes.
segments.zh: 接下来是大家最关心的PCE价格指数。

segments.en: The headline up, two tenths of 8% that is more than the one tenth expected.
segments.zh: 整体指数环比上涨0.2%，高于预期的0.1%。

segments.en: It was down a tenth in the month of June. The year over year number is 3.7% unchanged from what we saw in June.
segments.zh: 6月份曾下降0.1%，同比上涨3.7%，与6月持平。

segments.en: The core at two tenths of a percent is as expected.
segments.zh: 核心指数环比上涨0.2%，符合预期。

segments.en: And the year over year number stays at 3.3%.
So a slightly higher inflation number on the headline, which is probably due to the switching the energy numbers over the month.
segments.zh: 整体通胀略高，可能受当月能源价格波动影响。

segments.en: And whether that matters a lot to the Fed at this point is something we're going to learn in the next couple of hours or days.
segments.zh: 这对美联储是否重要，未来几小时或几天内会有答案。

segments.en: Personal income is up 4 tenths of 8%.
That's double what it was in the last month in June.
And double what was expected. Personal spending up 2 tenths of 8%.
segments.zh: 也是预期的两倍。个人支出增长0.2%。

segments.en: Less than the 3 tenths last month, but double what was expected. So a strong economy and still some inflation would tend to have you lean
segments.zh: 低于上月的0.3%，但高于预期。经济强劲且通胀仍在，这可能会增加美联储加息的概率。

segments.en: towards maybe increasing the odds of a Fed rate increase.
segments.zh: 倾向于增加美联储加息的可能性。

segments.en: As I mentioned, durable goods orders were up 1.1% and capital goods orders were up 2 tenths of 8%.
segments.zh: 如前所述，耐用品订单增长1.1%，资本品订单增长0.2%。

segments.en: They'd been up 1.2%, 1.7% now revised in the month of June.
segments.zh: 六月份的数据修正后为增长1.2%和1.7%。
